none: PAS LIN-A50AD8: Roman silver TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Description. 2018 T646: a Roman silver 'TOT' ring dating to the second or third century. The ring is of Henig type VIII and has a flat oval bezel inscribed with the letters TOT - an abbreviation of the Celtic god-name Totatis or Toutatis.
